title: EarthScience FieldLoggerSegmentDrift

stats.done_summary:
Completed the Soil-Moisture Campaign QA analysis (TWDM-based segment drift detection).

**Key results:**
- Golden-case validation: max absolute error = 0.00 × 10⁻⁹ (exact floating-point agreement on all 3 cases, well within the ≤ 1×10⁻⁹ requirement).
- Per-segment TWDM (in report order):
  | segment_id | n_frames | TWDM       | pass_fail            |
  |------------|----------|------------|----------------------|
  | FM_HEAD    | 400      | 0.13680936 | PASS                 |
  | FM_GAP     | 2        | N/A        | INSUFFICIENT_LENGTH  |
  | FM_MID     | 360      | 2.12306519 | FAIL                 |
  | FM_RIDGE   | 120      | 0.50757864 | PASS                 |
  | FM_TAIL    | 400      | 0.12039413 | PASS                 |

**Deliverables:**
- `code/analysis.py` — reproducible analysis script
- `outputs/segment_twdm_results.csv` and `outputs/summary.json` — intermediate results
- `report/images/vwc_fm_head.png` — VWC vs frame for FM_HEAD (captioned)
- `report/images/vwc_all_segments.png` — multi-panel overview of all segments
- `report/report.md` — full report with methodology, golden-case error, ordered results table, figures, and discussion
